Export the canonical graph reconstructed from the pinned Git revision

Usage: provenance graph-reference exact-export [OPTIONS] --reference <REFERENCE>

Options:
      --quiet                  Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --repo <REPO>            [default: .]
      --reference <REFERENCE>  
      --format <FORMAT>        [default: json] [possible values: json]
  -h, --help                   Print help
